After our order dated 10.01.2025, the Government has issued G.O.Ms.No.11 dated 06.02.2025 withdrawing the notification exempting the subject lands from the purview of the acquisition for formation of an Industrial Estate by SIPCOT.
2.

What remains to be done is to issue a 3(1) notification and proceed further in accordance with the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997.
